column1: # Custom 16MB partition table — identical to the stock default_16MB.csv except that the
# dead `spiffs` partition is replaced by `themeart`.
# Why: nothing in this firmware ever used SPIFFS. Spy Cam reads its JPEG frames from the
# microSD card (/spycam_frames/
# 3.375 MB sat unused from the first build. Theme art now lives there instead
# by Launch Kit into the exact RGB565 layout the panel wants
# it and draw straight from flash: no SD read
# Deliberately NOT reclaiming app1 (the 6.25 MB OTA slot). ArduinoOTA and the browser
# firmware-upload page in main.cpp both need a second app partition to write into
# buyer who cannot flash over USB has no other way to update. See
# partitions_16MB_video.csv for the layout that does reclaim it
# nvs stays at 0x9000 size 0x5000
# credentials survive this change. Flashing only writes the bootloader
# table and the app; nvs is never erased.
# Name
nvs
otadata
app0
app1
themeart
coredump
